title: Service request procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of bearers for data transfer or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Network response message indicating service request rejection, containing EMM cause value.

entities.name: EMM Cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for service request rejection.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state when service request procedure has been initiated.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state when registered with network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state when not registered with network.

entities.name: T3417
entities.description: Timer used during service request procedure.

entities.name: T3442
entities.description: Timer for CS service temporary unavailability.

entities.name: T3448
entities.description: Control plane data back-off timer for CIoT optimization.

entities.name: Integrity Protected Message
entities.description: Condition where SERVICE REJECT message is integrity protected.

entities.name: UE resets service request attempt counter
entities.description: UE behavior to reset service request attempt counter upon receiving SERVICE REJECT.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending SERVICE REJECT message when not accepted.
SERVICE REJECT message contains EMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Receipt of SERVICE REJECT stops timer T3417.
SERVICE REJECT message triggers UE to reset service request attempt counter.
SERVICE REJECT with EMM cause #22 starts back-off timer T3346.
SERVICE REJECT with EMM cause #39 starts timer T3442 if value not zero.
SERVICE REJECT with EMM cause #22 starts control plane data back-off timer T3448 for CIoT optimization.
Integrity protection condition determines how T3346 timer value is set.
Specific EMM cause values trigger transition to EMM-REGISTERED state.
Specific EMM cause values trigger transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
SERVICE REJECT message requires integrity protection for certain operations.
